title: ChurchRecord
description: BibleFi canonical record representing a church or faith community participating in the BibleFi protocol.

church_id.description: Unique identifier for this church record.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the church_record schema used.

name.description: Official name of the church or faith community.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the church is registered.

state_province.description: State, province, or region where the church is located.

city.description: City where the church is located.

wallet_address.description: Primary EVM-compatible wallet address for the church.

treasury_wallet.description: Dedicated treasury wallet address for tithe and offering receipts.

tax_exempt_id.description: Government-issued tax exemption identifier (e.g. US EIN for 501(c)(3) organizations).

governance_model.description: Church governance structure. 'dao' indicates on-chain decentralized governance.

on_chain_id.description: On-chain contract or identity address representing this church in the BibleFi protocol.

ipfs_metadata_cid.description: IPFS CIDv0 or CIDv1 of extended church metadata stored off-chain.

verified.description: Whether the church has been verified by the BibleFi protocol governance.

tags.description: Searchable tags associated with this church (e.g. 'charismatic', 'urban', 'missions-focused').

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this record.
